items.title: 4.3.1 Combining Stacks and Queues to Evaluate Expressions

source_refs.note: Topic 4.3.1 (PDF 118, printed 115). The section gives no example; the answer is general knowledge, flagged.

blocks.text: Stacks and queues are powerful tools in evaluating mathematical expressions, especially when the expressions involve complex operations. By combining these two data structures, we can efficiently manage the order of operations, handle parentheses, and ensure the correct evaluation of expressions.
